props.text: We are an independent garage with factory-trained technicians and modern diagnostics, servicing.
SERVICING AND REPAIRS FOR EVERY MAKE
Factory-trained technicians, modern diagnostics and a written quote before we touch your car.
You get a written quote before we start, photos of anything we replace, and a twelve-month warranty on parts and labour.
Manufacturer-schedule services that keep your warranty.
We are an independent garage with factory-trained technicians and modern diagnostics, servicing every make since 2006.
We listen first and agree what success looks like.

Our own team on the work, checked at every stage.

props.question: Will servicing here affect my warranty?
props.answer: No. We follow the manufacturer schedule and use approved parts.

props.question: Do you give quotes first?
props.answer: Always, in writing, before any work starts.

props.question: Can you collect my car?
props.answer: Yes, within the city, for a small fee or free on major services.

props.question: Do you work with insurers?
props.answer: We are approved by all major insurers for accident repairs.
